title: Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, IBM, and others back open-weight AI
slides: Why are tech giants suddenly backing open-weight AI?
Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, and IBM signed a joint pledge.
The same companies once fiercely guarded their own models.
You can now inspect and modify models they previously locked.
Run a rival model on your own hardware today.
thread_text:
1. The open-weight surrender

Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, and IBM just signed a joint pledge to open their AI models.

2. From fortress to free

These same companies spent years locking down their top models behind proprietary walls.

3. Inspect and modify

Anyone can now inspect, tweak, or even copy the model code they formerly guarded.

4. Hardware independence

You can download a rival model and run it on your own machine today.

5. Your move

Which model will you inspect and modify first this week?
